'''2011 German National Championship Gosse Zeilstra DS Executor: Meditation Chamber''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Gosse Zeilstra]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Meditation Chamber|Dagobah-D-executormeditationchamber.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Flagship Operations Bombers
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
